title: ProgramBrief
description: The planner's one-shot output for a Program. Decomposes a parent WorkItem{kind: program} into a DAG of child WorkItems. Immutable post-publication; the planner runs exactly once per program. See docs/design.md §Programs §Planner contract.

program_id.description: Stable program ID. Format mirrors handoff.schema.json.

parent_work_item_id.description: ID of the parent WorkItem{kind: program} the planner decomposed.

parent_criteria.description: VERBATIM copy of the parent WorkItem's acceptance criteria at plan-time. Stored for L0 byte-equality at publish + at each child handoff (P3, P10).

features.description: Child WorkItems in topological order. Every parent_criteria[].id MUST appear in exactly one feature.fulfills.

id.description: Stable child ID. Planner-assigned; unique within a program.

fulfills.description: Parent criterion IDs this feature claims. Coverage invariant: union over all features == parent_criteria[*].id; pairwise disjoint.

depends_on_features.description: Other feature IDs that must complete before this one spawns. DAG; cycles rejected at validate time.
